harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as the router between node2 (lan-a) and node3 (lan-b), adding two interfaces (opt1=vtnet1=10.50.1.1/24, opt2=vtnet2=10.50.2.1/24) and exactly one firewall pass rule: TCP/8080 from opt1(lan-a) network to opt2(lan-b) network. All other opt1<->opt2 traffic remains blocked by the existing default-deny ruleset. Static addressing (10.50.1.10/24 and 10.50.2.10/24 respectively, with cross routes via node1) was persisted on node2/node3 via NetworkManager, and node3's firewalld was opened for 8080 to allow the test listener. Verified end-to-end before and after a full one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes: TCP 8080 (node2->node3) succeeds, ICMP and other ports between the two networks are refused, and the reverse direction (node3->node2) is fully refused. Each node's boot identity (FreeBSD kern.boottime for node1; /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for node2/node3) was captured before and after its reboot and confirmed changed, with functional recovery re-verified after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (OPNsense/FreeBSD) interfaces and config.xml; identified vtnet0=management/lan, vtnet1 and vtnet2 unassigned
Inspected node2/node3 (AlmaLinux) interfaces; found eth0=management, eth1 unaddressed for lan-a/lan-b
Used temporary ifconfig/ip addr + ARP reachability tests to confirm vtnet1<->node2(eth1) and vtnet2<->node3(eth1) pairing
Persisted static IPs 10.50.1.10/24 (node2) and 10.50.2.10/24 (node3) on eth1 via nmcli, plus cross-subnet static routes via node1

Edited /conf/config.xml on node1 via Python/ElementTree (with backup) to add opt1 (vtnet1, 10.50.1.1/24) and opt2 (vtnet2, 10.50.2.1/24) interfaces and one filter rule: pass tcp opt1-net -> opt2-net port 8080
Applied config via configctl filter reload; verified via pfctl -sr that only the port-8080 pass rule exists between opt1/opt2, and the existing vtnet0 SSH/mgmt pass rules were untouched
Opened tcp/8080 in node3 firewalld (runtime+permanent) and started a test HTTP listener on 10.50.2.10:8080
Verified from node2: HTTP on 8080 succeeds (200), ping and other ports to node3 are refused; verified reverse direction node3->node2 fully refused
Captured pre-restart boot-identity/health baselines on all three nodes
Restarted node2, then node3, then node1 one at a time via 'shutdown -r now' backgrounded for ack-before-disconnect; polled each until exec returned; confirmed boot_id/kern.boottime changed on each
Re-verified persisted network config and the single-port firewall behavior end-to-end after all three restarts

evidence.requirement: Baseline: node1 config, interfaces, forwarding sysctl, existing default-deny filter
evidence.summary: node1 identified as OPNsense/FreeBSD with vtnet0=management (default-deny), vtnet1/vtnet2 unassigned, ip.forwarding=1
ARP reachability tests confirmed node2 eth1 pairs with vtnet1 and node3 eth1 pairs with vtnet2

evidence.requirement: Persist static addressing on node2/node3 lan interfaces
evidence.summary: nmcli-configured static IPs and cross-subnet routes on eth1 for both nodes, persisted via NetworkManager connection profiles

evidence.requirement: Single allowed path: node1 opens exactly TCP/8080 lan-a->lan-b, all else refused
evidence.summary: config.xml mutated to add opt1/opt2 interfaces and one pass rule for tcp/8080 opt1->opt2; pf ruleset confirms only that rule plus untouched vtnet0 SSH/mgmt rules

evidence.requirement: Functional proof: 8080 works, other flows refused, both directions tested
evidence.summary: curl to 10.50.2.10:8080 returns 200; ping and port 9090 refused; reverse node3->node2 on 8080 and ping also refused

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 717db5a2->a599f9e6 after shutdown -r now; static IP/route and 8080 connectivity confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 84419b90->d411a254 after reboot; static IP/route/firewalld port persisted; 8080 listener restarted and verified reachable from node2

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state and cluster forwarding/firewall config
evidence.summary: kern.boottime 1788625456->1788625760 after shutdown -r now; interfaces, forwarding, and the single port-8080 pass rule persisted from config.xml; full end-to-end path re-verified working with all other flows still refused
